[[Ghial's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Ghial the Bone Dancer]], a [[boss]] located in [[Xaquang Skyway]].

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of Death Magic spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Death Magic +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:Energy +5

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Bone Staff]] [[dye]]d silver.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated. All collector and crafter staves that require Death Magic inflict [[cold damage]]. 


It is possible to create a cold damage version of this item (including visual appearance) with:
*[[Bone Staff]] from collectors [[Keotah]], [[Luven Underwood]], [[Merin Trollsbane]], or [[Adept Bishu]] or crafters [[Manzo]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] of [[Of Attribute|Death Magic]] OR [[Of Mastery|Mastery]] 
*Silver [[dye]]*
<nowiki>*</nowiki>Not all variants of the Bone Staff can be dyed.
